statBlock.name: Black Pudding
statBlock.description: An ink-black ooze that dissolves wood, metal, and whatever else stands in its way.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It can fit through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
Corrosive Form. A creature that hits the pudding with a melee attack roll takes 4 (1d8) Acid damage. Destroy nonmagical ammunition immediately after it hits and deals damage to the ooze. When a nonmagical weapon touches the ooze and deals damage to it, the weapon immediately gains a cumulative −1 penalty to its attack rolls. At −5, the weapon is destroyed. Mending removes the penalty from a surviving weapon. The pudding eats through 2 ft. of nonmagical wood or metal in 1 minute.
Spider Climb. It climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Dissolving Pseudopod. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 17 (4d6 + 3) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a −1 penalty to the AC it provides. If this lowers the armor's AC to 10, the armor is destroyed. Mending removes the penalty from surviving armor.
sections.Reactions: Split. A Medium or Large pudding with at least 10 HP can react when it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Replace it with two of the same kind, each one size smaller. They act on the original's initiative and each receives half its current HP, rounded down.

statBlock.name: Gray Ooze
statBlock.description: A slab-gray ooze that creeps along walls and corrodes armor with a touch.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It can fit through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
Corrosive Form. Destroy nonmagical ammunition immediately after it hits and deals damage to the ooze. When a nonmagical weapon touches the ooze and deals damage to it, the weapon immediately gains a cumulative −1 penalty to its attack rolls. At −5, the weapon is destroyed. Mending removes the penalty from a surviving weapon. The ooze eats through 2 inches of nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.
sections.Actions: Pseudopod. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d8 + 1) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a −1 penalty to the AC it provides. If this lowers the armor's AC to 10, the armor is destroyed. Mending removes the penalty from surviving armor.

statBlock.name: Ochre Jelly
statBlock.description: A yellow-brown jelly that scales cave ceilings and divides when cut.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It can fit through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
Spider Climb. It climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Pseudopod. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.
sections.Reactions: Split. A Medium or Large jelly with at least 10 HP can react when it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Replace it with two of the same kind, each one size smaller. They act on the original's initiative and each receives half its current HP, rounded down.

statBlock.name: Psychic Gray Ooze
statBlock.description: This gray ooze can assault a creature's thoughts and retaliate when that creature's magic overcomes it.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained.
sections.Traits: Amorphous. It can fit through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
sections.Actions:
Pseudopod. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (3d6 + 1) Acid damage. The target has Disadvantage on Intelligence saves until the end of the ooze's next turn.
Psychic Crush. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. It makes a DC 10 Intelligence save, taking 13 (3d8) Psychic damage on a failure.
sections.Reactions: Mind Corrosion. When the ooze fails a save against a creature's spell or other magical effect, that creature takes 3 (1d6) Psychic damage.

statBlock.name: Water Weird
statBlock.description: A water elemental tethered to a particular body of water. It surges out to seize creatures within reach.

sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Invisible in Water. The weird is Invisible while completely submerged.
Water Bound. It dies if it leaves the water it is bound to or that water is destroyed.
sections.Actions: Surge. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 13 (3d6 + 3) Cold damage. A Medium or smaller creature is also Grappled (escape DC 13) and Restrained until that grapple ends.

statBlock.name: Galeb Duhr
statBlock.speed: 15 ft. (30 ft. when rolling, 60 ft. rolling downhill)
statBlock.description: A boulder-shaped elemental that rolls downhill and calls nearby rocks to life.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Actions:
Avalanche Slam. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the galeb duhr moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it immediately before hitting, deal an extra 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and knock it Prone.
Animate Boulders (1/day). Magically animate one or two visible boulders within 60 ft. Each uses the Galeb Duhr stat block with Intelligence and Charisma 1 and without Animate Boulders. It obeys the galeb duhr and takes its turn immediately after it on the same initiative count. It stays animated for 1 minute or until either it or the galeb duhr dies.

statBlock.name: Xorn
statBlock.description: A burrowing earth elemental that can pinpoint nearby gems and precious metals.

sections.Traits:
Earth Glide. The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material.
Treasure Sense. It pinpoints precious metals and stones within 60 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and three Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 17 (4d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
Claw. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Charge. Move up to the xorn's Speed or Burrow Speed straight toward an enemy it can sense.
